summary: Caxton Press is the publishing division of The Caxton Printers Ltd., founded in Caldwell in 1895 by A. E. Gipson as the Gem State Rural Publishing Company and renamed in 1903. Regular book publishing began in 1925, and the division was renamed Caxton Press around 1995 to distinguish it from the parent company, which also sells office and school supplies.
one_line: Caxton Press is the book publishing division of The Caxton Printers Ltd., founded in Caldwell in 1895 and renamed in the 1990s.
key_facts: Caxton Press is the publishing division of The Caxton Printers Ltd.
The Caxton Printers was founded in Caldwell in 1895 by A. E. Gipson.
The company was first named the Gem State Rural Publishing Company.
The company was renamed to The Caxton Printers in 1903.
Regular publishing of books began in 1925.
The Caxton Printers was named after William Caxton, printer of the first-ever book in English, in 1474.
The publishing division was named Caxton Printers until around 1995.
Around 1995 the publishing division was renamed Caxton Press to differentiate it from the parent company.
The parent company now also engages in non-publishing business.
The parent company sells office supplies and school supplies.
